result:
Notes written to `/tmp/7z-notes/info-command.md`. Reproducer proving the layout: `/tmp/7z-probe/info/repro/gen.py` (regenerates all 1776 bytes, `cmp`-clean).

**Key findings**

Exit code 0; **all 1776 bytes go to stdout (fd 1)**, nothing to stderr. `-bso2` moves the whole thing (banner included) to fd 2, proving it uses the "out messages" channel. Output identical on TTY vs pipe, and locale-independent.

Structure: `"\n"` + 2 banner lines + `"\n"` + `"\n"` + `Formats:` … `Codecs:` … `Hashers:`. First byte of output is `0x0A`. `-ba`/`-bso0`/`-so` strip a 125-byte banner block but the body's own leading blank line survives (1651 B).

Exact line format strings (all three verified byte-identical):
```
format:  "   " + FLAGS(23) + "  " + ljust(name,8) + " " + ljust(exts,13) + " " + sig
codec:   "   " + FLAGS4    + "%9X" % id + " " + name
hasher:  "%7d" % digestBytes + "%9X" % id + " " + name
```
So format cols: 0-2 spaces, 3-25 flags (23 wide), 26-27 spaces, 28-35 name, 36 space, 37-49 exts, 50 space, 51+ signature. Codec/hasher share a 7-wide first field, ID right-aligned ending at col 15, name at col 17.

**Trailing spaces exist** on 4 format lines (Split, lzma, lzma86 → len 51; Hash → 1 trailing space) because the exts field is padded to 13 and the separator space is emitted even when the signature is empty. Proven by bzip2 (exts=32 chars → signature starts at col 70, i.e. single-space separator, not "align to col 51").

Flags string is **23 chars**, off-char `.` — except the first position whose off-char is a **space** (`Cab` = `" ...F.................."`). 9 of the 23 positions are `.` for every format. Letters observed: `C K . . F M G O . . . L H X C c . a . m + . .`. `C` = has updater — **proven**: exactly the 7 `C` formats accept `a -t<fmt>`; the 5 others fail exit 2 with `\n\nSystem ERROR:\nE_NOTIMPL : Not implemented\n`. `M` = multi-signature (zip only, matches the `  ||  `-joined display).

IDs are **uppercase hex, no `0x`, no leading zeros** (`Copy` prints `0`). Hasher sizes are decimal bytes (4, 20, 32, 8, 8). Only 5 hashers listed despite the Hash format advertising 23 extension names.

`-slt` has **no effect**. `-t<type>` is **validated then ignored** — `i -t7z` is byte-identical to `i`. Invalid type → exit **2**, stdout gets the 125-byte banner, stderr gets `b'\n\nERROR:\nUnsupported archive type\n'`. `-t` alone → exit **7**, stderr `b'\n\nCommand Line Error:\nToo short switch:\n-t\n'`, stdout empty. `-bt` appends a 5-line timing block; `-h` overrides the command entirely.

Signature display rule: bytes space-separated, printable ASCII as the char else 2 uppercase hex digits (`37 7A BC AF 27 1C` → `7 z BC AF ' 1C`); non-zero offset prefixed `offset=257 `; alternatives joined by `"  ||  "`.

Full machine-usable Python tables for all 12 formats, 21 codecs and 5 hashers are in section 10 of the notes.
